name: Ulthera & Shurink
alias: High-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) lifting · including Liftera and LinearZ
skin: Ultrasound heat reaches the deep layers of the skin, leaving almost no wound on the surface. Redness usually settles within a few hours, and the jawline and cheeks may feel tender or slightly swollen for a few days.
sunWhen: From the day of the procedure
sunHow: Once the warmth settles, apply to your whole face before heading home.
Don't rub tender areas along the jawline and cheeks; spread it on gently with your palms, pressing lightly.
Apply 30 minutes before going out and reapply every 2–3 hours.
cleanWhen: From the evening of the procedure
cleanHow: Many clinics advise avoiding facial massage for a while after lifting. Until your clinic says it's okay, spread it on without the rolling massage and rinse right away.
avoid: Avoid saunas, alcohol, and strenuous exercise for a few days.
Take a short break from scrubs and peeling products.
product: In a test where skin was warmed with infrared light, the temperature of the treated cheek dropped by 4.85℃ right after application (Elid Co., Ltd., 22 women). This test was not performed on skin right after a procedure.
SPF50+ PA++++ blocks both UVA and UVB.

name: Thermage, InMode & Oligio
alias: Radiofrequency (RF) lifting · including Density, TuneFace, and similar devices
skin: These procedures heat the inside of the skin with radiofrequency energy. Redness and a burning sensation usually settle within 2–3 hours, but depending on your skin they can last up to two days. Mild swelling may also occur.
sunWhen: From the day of the procedure in most cases
sunHow: Apply to your whole face once the warmth has settled.
Some clinics advise washing your face and wearing makeup only from the next day. In that case, cover up with a hat or parasol on the day and start applying the next day.
If your skin feels dry, apply moisturizer first, then layer sunscreen on top.
cleanWhen: From the day of the procedure, or when your clinic advises
cleanHow: Some clinics recommend washing with lukewarm water instead of cold water.
So for a few days after the procedure, skip the cleansing milk's ‘cold-water finish’ tip and rinse with lukewarm water.
Don't rub; spread it on lightly and rinse.
avoid: Avoid saunas, jjimjilbang (Korean bathhouses), swimming pools, and heavy drinking for about a week.
Take about a week off from peeling treatments and scrubs.
product: A milk-type cleanser you spread directly onto a dry face, with no need to foam.
The cleansing milk scored 0.00 for skin irritation in a 24-hour patch test and was rated non-irritating (Korea Institute of Dermatological Sciences, 31 participants).

name: Titanium lifting
skin: Laser heat reaches the skin's supporting structures. Redness and a burning sensation settle quickly, but tenderness, swelling, and mild bruising may last 1–2 weeks, and skin tends to become dry.
sunWhen: From the day of the procedure
sunHow: Apply plenty of moisturizing cream, then layer sunscreen on top.
Don't press on bruised or tender areas; lay it on gently.
cleanWhen: From the day of the procedure, gently
cleanHow: Many clinics advise avoiding facial meridian massage and other massage for about 2 weeks. During this time, spread it on without the rolling massage and rinse right away.
avoid: Avoid alcohol, smoking, saunas, jjimjilbang, and excessive exercise for about a week.
Avoid scrubs, peels, and facial meridian massage for about 2 weeks.
product: In a usage survey, all 22 respondents said their skin ‘felt moisturized from within’ (right after application, self-assessment).
SPF50+ PA++++; skin irritation score of 0.00 in a 24-hour patch test (Elid Co., Ltd., 34 participants).

name: ONDA lifting
skin: Microwave heat is delivered into the skin. Redness, warmth, and slight swelling may last a few hours, and the treated area may feel tender.
sunWhen: From the day of the procedure
sunHow: Once the warmth settles, apply a moisturizing cream, then apply sunscreen generously.
Apply 30 minutes before going out and reapply every 2–3 hours.
cleanWhen: From the day of the procedure
cleanHow: On tender areas, don't roll; spread it on and rinse right away.
avoid: Avoid saunas, jjimjilbang, strenuous exercise, and alcohol for a week.
product: In a test on skin warmed with infrared light, the temperature of the treated cheek dropped by 4.85℃ right after application (Elid Co., Ltd., 22 women). This test was not performed on skin right after a procedure.

name: Laser toning
skin: A low-power laser, so there is almost no surface wound. Slight redness and a burning sensation settle within a few hours, and occasionally tiny scabs or dryness may occur.
sunWhen: From the day of the procedure
sunHow: Toning is often done over several sessions. Daily application between sessions is the basic rule.
Apply 30 minutes before going out and reapply every 2–3 hours.
cleanWhen: From the day of the procedure
cleanHow: Don't rub; spread it on lightly, rinse, and pat dry with a towel.
If tiny scabs form, don't pick them off; let them fall off on their own.
avoid: Avoid heavy drinking, saunas, and strenuous exercise.
product: A triple-function sunscreen for UV protection, brightening, and anti-wrinkle care (niacinamide, adenosine).
Some clinics advise taking a break from brightening and anti-wrinkle functional cosmetics right after the procedure. If you were given that advice, follow your clinic during that period.

name: IPL
skin: Redness may occur, and blemishes may darken temporarily before flaking off.
sunWhen: From the day of the procedure
sunHow: Apply thoroughly, including over darkened blemishes.
Don't rub over darkened blemishes; lay it on gently.
cleanWhen: From the evening of the procedure
cleanHow: Until the darkened blemishes flake off, spread it on lightly without the rolling massage and rinse.
avoid: Take a short break from exfoliants, scrubs, and retinol.
product: SPF50+ PA++++ protects against both UVA and UVB (SPF 53.9, UVAPF 18.6).
Skin irritation score of 0.00 in a 24-hour patch test, rated non-irritating (Elid Co., Ltd., 34 participants).

name: Vascular lasers
alias: Redness lasers · Vbeam, Excel V, and more
skin: Redness may temporarily deepen with slight swelling (a few hours to 1–2 days). In some cases purple bruising may appear and last from a few days to about 2 weeks.
sunWhen: From the day of the procedure
sunHow: Don't rub bruised areas; pat it on with your fingertips.
Skin treated with a laser may be sensitive to sunlight for a while, so the habit of applying every day matters.
cleanWhen: From the evening of the procedure
cleanHow: Use lukewarm water instead of hot water.
Spread it on lightly without the rolling massage and rinse.
If scabs form, leave them alone; don't pick them off.
avoid: Avoid saunas, heavy drinking, and exercise that makes you sweat a lot for a few days.
product: Skin irritation score of 0.00 in a 24-hour patch test, rated non-irritating (Elid Co., Ltd., 34 participants).
